sources.title: European Commission Better Regulation toolbox
sources.applicability: EU Commission; not a mandatory business-report format
sources.reviewNote: Lists impact, evaluation and consultation tools; use relevant tools, not every institutional procedure.

sources.title: HM Treasury business case guidance landing page
sources.applicability: UK public-sector business cases
sources.reviewNote: Links to the current June 2026 guide; not a Europe-wide report mandate.

sources.title: Horizon Europe RIA/IA Standard Application Form v10
sources.applicability: HE RIA/IA only; live call template takes priority
sources.reviewNote: Read the example form and work-plan tables; it explicitly warns that call forms may differ.

sources.title: British Business Bank pitch-deck guidance
sources.applicability: Startup investment communication, not a due-diligence standard
sources.reviewNote: Problem, market, model, evidence, team, funding ask and assumptions inform investor-facing reports.

sources.title: Georgetown Law Tips for Effective Organization
sources.applicability: US legal-writing teaching; structure only, not European substantive law
sources.reviewNote: Use issue hierarchy and clear rule-to-fact reasoning; obtain governing law separately.

sources.title: UK Assessment Summaries guidance
sources.applicability: UK Procurement Act procedures where applicable
sources.reviewNote: Criteria and reasons help benchmark outcome reviews; do not impose UK processes across Europe.

sources.title: ESA legacy Business Applications documents
sources.applicability: Page limits proposal use to pre-25 November 2025 APQs
sources.reviewNote: Do not treat old templates as current; follow BASS and the actual tender action.

sources.title: IPO Lambert Toolkit
sources.applicability: English-law collaboration; dated guidance
sources.reviewNote: Voluntary starting points with stated jurisdiction and update caveats; not a universal contract.

sources.title: SBA market research and competitive analysis
sources.applicability: US guidance; general analytical concepts only
sources.reviewNote: Demand, location, alternatives and barriers inform commercial research; use local evidence.

sources.title: Strategyzer Value Proposition Canvas public guide
sources.applicability: Optional commercial framework; no certification claim
sources.reviewNote: Customer needs and offer fit require validation. No proprietary canvas is reproduced.

sources.title: EBN EU BIC certification framework overview
sources.applicability: Business incubators; not certification of Bravestar reports
sources.reviewNote: Support, ecosystem, startup outcomes and finance access inform portfolio checks; detailed audit standards were not obtained.

sources.title: UK shoreline stakeholder engagement strategy appendix
sources.applicability: Legacy coastal planning; method only
sources.reviewNote: Purpose, participants, methods and responsibility illustrate engagement planning; obsolete institutions are not reused.

sources.title: Better Regulation toolbox Chapter 2
sources.applicability: Commission impact assessments; adapted business analysis
sources.reviewNote: Problem, baseline, objectives, options, impacts and comparison provide a policy assessment benchmark.

sources.title: Better Regulation toolbox Chapter 7
sources.applicability: Commission consultations; business responses follow the actual consultation
sources.reviewNote: Scope, affected stakeholders, methods and analysis of consultation evidence inform engagement reports.

sources.title: ESA BASS documents
sources.applicability: Relevant BASS scheme and stage only
sources.reviewNote: Lists current questionnaires and outline templates; official action versions govern.

sources.title: HM Treasury business case guide 2026
sources.applicability: UK public investment; adapted to business planning
sources.reviewNote: Strategic rationale, options, affordability, commercial delivery and management inform integrated business cases.

sources.title: ESA BASS Activity Pitch Questionnaire
sources.applicability: Specific call and its current form only
sources.reviewNote: Only opening instructions and field identifiers extracted. Dynamic content not fully readable; no full-form validation claimed.

sources.title: BDC business proposal guidance
sources.applicability: Commercial proposals; no universal mandated format
sources.reviewNote: Client need, proposed solution, costs, timing, outcomes and exclusions inform sales reports.

sources.title: Reuters Standards and Values
sources.applicability: News verification principles; not an endorsement
sources.reviewNote: Attribution, verification and corrections inform monthly news reports; no proprietary text copied.

sources.title: ESA How to use PSS forms
sources.applicability: ESA ITTs where required by current instructions
sources.reviewNote: Cost transparency and reconciliation inform bid reviews; current ITT decides forms and versions.

sources.title: ESA ACCESS BASS Pilot outline v1.1 18 December 2025
sources.applicability: Pilot outline only; verify current tender instructions
sources.reviewNote: Read business, technical, management and financial sections. National delegation and stage conditions require call-specific checks.

sources.title: BDC business proposal template page
sources.applicability: Actual Word download requires a form
sources.reviewNote: Reviewed public component list, not gated Word contents. Did not submit personal details.
